core_obligations: Choose the three surjective etale presentations and note that U x_W V -> X x_B Y is surjective etale, so it suffices to prove the vanishing after restriction (proof lines 4806-4812).
Use the comparison lemma and the Tor independence result to reduce to the case of schemes (proof lines 4812-4814).
Reduce to affine schemes by taking suitable affine opens (proof lines 4815-4815).
Use the affine comparison lemma to reduce to a tensor product of rings and conclude with the ring-level lemma (proof lines 4816-4819).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: in the situation of the fibre product equation, if X and Y are Tor independent over B then the object E of that equation is zero and consequently L_{X x_B Y/B} = Lp^*L_{X/B} (+) Lq^*L_{Y/B} (source lines 4796-4804). The proof is a three-stage descent to the affine scheme case: it chooses surjective etale presentations W -> B, U -> X x_B W and V -> Y x_B W, notes that U x_W V -> X x_B Y is surjective etale so that it suffices to show the restriction of E to U x_W V vanishes, uses the comparison lemma and the Tor independence result for derived categories of spaces to reduce to schemes, then to affine schemes by taking affine opens, and finally to a tensor product of rings via the affine-schemes comparison lemma.
